content.text: Done. I noticed the request was internally inconsistent — "25 points" with phi "0 to 345 in 25 steps" doesn't match the standard 15°-spacing convention (which gives only 24 points over that range) — so I resolved it by using 25 evenly-spaced phi values from 0° to 345° (step ≈14.375°), keeping both the exact point count and the stated range. All 25 points passed preflight (W=1.6 GeV is safely above the 1.486 GeV eta threshold, cos θ*=0 avoids the pole, kinematics fall inside the table coverage). Wrote 3 chunked EXCLURAD input files (10/10/5 points, respecting the Fortran reader's 10-point limit) plus `outcome.json` documenting the fix, all in the working directory.
